name: tennis-evolution
description: Turn a long tennis recording into a labeled highlight reel: lossless rally clips, hit-count labels, self-checks.
long_description:
Give Claude a long tennis recording and a rally list (time ranges, optionally hit counts, e.g. a sliceapp export or your own notes). Tennis Evolution cuts keyframe-aligned lossless clips, assembles a sync-correct reel in one encode, burns hit count / venue / wall clock / source timestamp onto the picture, and self-checks every output (decode errors, A/V offset and duration, black frames, silence).

Everything runs on your machine; video never leaves it. Requires **ffmpeg** and **ffprobe** (macOS: `brew install ffmpeg`, Debian/Ubuntu: `apt install ffmpeg fonts-noto-cjk`).

Free version keeps the 5 best rallies and adds a small watermark; a Pro licence removes both (https://tennis-evolution.pages.dev/#pricing).

tools.name: probe_video
tools.description: Read duration, resolution, rotation, HDR/colour, audio tracks and recording time of a local video file. Run this first to confirm the file is readable.

tools.name: rank_highlights
tools.description: Parse a rally list and show which rallies would be kept, so the user can confirm before rendering.

tools.name: start_highlight_reel
tools.description: Start the full pipeline in the background: lossless keyframe-aligned clips, a plain reel, a labeled reel (hit count / venue / wall clock / source timestamp) and manifest.json with self-check results. Returns a job_id; poll get_job. A 47-minute iPhone HDR recording with 5 rallies takes 3-5 minutes on an M-series Mac.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Status of a job from start_highlight_reel: running/done/failed, the last log lines, and once done the manifest (outputs and verification).

tools.name: verify_video
tools.description: Clean decode, zero start offset, A/V duration match, non-black first/last frame, non-silent audio.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Whether a Pro licence is active, the free-tier limits and the pricing URL.

tools.name: activate_license
tools.description: Verify a te1.… key offline and store it for future renders.

license_key.title: Pro licence key
license_key.description: Optional te1.… key. Leave empty for the free version (5 rallies, small watermark).

ffmpeg_dir.title: ffmpeg folder
ffmpeg_dir.description: Optional folder that contains ffmpeg and ffprobe. Leave empty to use PATH, /opt/homebrew/bin or /usr/local/bin.
